# 🐙 GitHub Configurations (`.github/`)

Autonomous microservice GitHub repository configurations, AI copilot instructions, and CI/CD automation workflows.

---

## 📦 Directory Structure

* **[`copilot-instructions.md`](copilot-instructions.md)**: AI agent directives and 14 pre-flight checks specifically formatted for GitHub Copilot.
* **[`pull_request_template.md`](pull_request_template.md)**: Standard pull request template with DCO 1.1 and pre-commit verification gates.
* **[`workflows/`](workflows/)**: Standalone GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows:
  * **`pipeline.yml`**: Bun runtime testing and 18-check verification gate.
  * **`dco.yml`**: Developer Certificate of Origin (`Signed-off-by:`) enforcement.
* **[`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/)**: Standardized issue forms for bug reports, feature requests, and security vulnerabilities.
